requirements.text: If the rear combination lamp is approved as an electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) under UN R10, an approval mark as described in paragraph 5.3 shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to the approved type. No marking is required if the electronics are built into a vehicle that is approved as a unit.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of production samples and drawings: when ESA approval under UN R10 is held, check that the paragraph 5.3 approval mark is present on every unit of the approved type. Pass if the mark is present on all units. If the lamp is covered only by the vehicle's R10 approval, confirm that this is documented.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp, as an ESA, shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of UN Regulation No. 10.
requirements.test_case: Design review and fitting check of the lamp ESA as installed on the M1 vehicle. Pass if the ESA passes the UN R10 ESA tests (para. 6.1.1.2) and does not cause the vehicle to fail UN R10 radiated emission or immunity limits under normal conditions of use.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp, as an ESA, shall be tested for radiated emissions.
requirements.test_case: ESA radiated emissions test per UN R10 ESA broadband/narrowband radiated emission annexes, with each function (rear position, stop, reversing) energised. Pass if emissions stay at or below the ESA reference limits.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp, as an ESA, shall be tested for conducted emissions.
requirements.test_case: ESA conducted emissions test on the supply lines per the relevant UN R10 annexes, with each lighting function energised. Pass if conducted emissions/transients stay within the specified limits.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp, as an ESA, shall be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances.
requirements.test_case: ESA radiated immunity test per the UN R10 ESA immunity annex, with the functions monitored. Pass if there is no degradation of the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions, e.g. no unintended switching, flicker or loss of light output, at the required field strength.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp, as an ESA, shall be tested for immunity to conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: ESA conducted immunity/transient test on the supply lines per the relevant UN R10 annex, with the functions monitored. Pass if the lighting functions show no malfunction during or after the applied disturbances, according to the agreed functional status.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission measurement over 30-75 MHz with the lamp functions energised. Pass if all values are below the logarithmically decreasing limit line from 62 dBµV/m at 30 MHz to 52 dBµV/m at 75 MHz (Appendix 6).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission measurement over 75-400 MHz with the lamp functions energised. Pass if all values are below the logarithmically increasing limit line from 52 dBµV/m at 75 MHz to 63 dBµV/m at 400 MHz (Appendix 6).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission measurement over 400-1,000 MHz with the lamp functions energised. Pass if all values are below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: On the rear combination lamp ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare the Annex 7 broadband results across 30-1,000 MHz for each operating mode (position, stop, reversing, combined) with the 6.5.2.1 limit curve. Pass if every measured value is strictly below the limit.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 narrowband emission scan from 30 to 75 MHz with the rear position, stop and reversing functions operating; pass if every narrowband emission is below the logarithmically decreasing limit of 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m (Appendix 7).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz, as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 narrowband emission scan from 75 to 400 MHz with the lamp functions operating; pass if every narrowband emission is below the logarithmically increasing limit of 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m (Appendix 7).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 narrowband emission scan from 400 to 1,000 MHz with the lamp functions operating; pass if every narrowband emission is below 53 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare the Annex 8 narrowband measurement results of the representative sample against the 6.6.2.1 limit curve over 30 to 1,000 MHz; pass if all measured values are below the limits.

requirements.text: For ESAs intended for vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances on the supply lines shall be +75 V.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 measurement on a 12 V supply with each lamp function switched on and off. Pass if the positive pulse amplitude is ≤ +75 V.

requirements.text: For ESAs intended for vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances on the supply lines shall be -100 V.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 measurement on a 12 V supply with each lamp function switched on and off. Pass if the negative pulse amplitude does not exceed -100 V in magnitude.

requirements.text: When tested by the stripline method of Annex 9, the rear combination lamp ESA shall withstand a test level of 60 V/m in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range over more than 90 per cent of the band (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 stripline test, 20 to 400 MHz at 60 V/m. Pass if there is no degradation of the position, stop or reversing functions over more than 90 per cent of the frequency band.

requirements.text: When tested by the stripline method of Annex 9, the rear combination lamp ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 50 V/m over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 stripline test, 20 to 400 MHz at 50 V/m. Pass if there is no degradation of the lamp functions at any frequency.

requirements.text: When tested by the TEM cell method of Annex 9, the rear combination lamp ESA shall withstand a test level of 75 V/m in the 20 to 200 MHz frequency range over more than 90 per cent of the band (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 TEM cell test, 20 to 200 MHz at 75 V/m. Pass if there is no degradation of the lamp functions over more than 90 per cent of the band.

requirements.text: When tested by the TEM cell method of Annex 9, the rear combination lamp ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 62,5 V/m over the whole 20 to 200 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 TEM cell test, 20 to 200 MHz at 62,5 V/m. Pass if there is no degradation of the lamp functions at any frequency.

requirements.text: When tested by the BCI method of Annex 9, the rear combination lamp ESA shall withstand a test level of 60 mA in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range over more than 90 per cent of the band (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 bulk current injection on the lamp harness, 20 to 400 MHz at 60 mA. Pass if there is no degradation of the lamp functions over more than 90 per cent of the band.

requirements.text: When tested by the BCI method of Annex 9, the rear combination lamp ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 bulk current injection, 20 to 400 MHz at 50 mA. Pass if there is no degradation of the lamp functions at any frequency.

requirements.text: When tested by the ALSE method of Annex 9, the rear combination lamp ESA shall withstand a test level of 30 V/m in the 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency range over more than 90 per cent of the band (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 absorber-lined shielded enclosure test, 80 to 2,000 MHz at 30 V/m. Pass if there is no degradation of the lamp functions over more than 90 per cent of the band.

requirements.text: When tested by the ALSE method of Annex 9, the rear combination lamp ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 25 V/m over the whole 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 ALSE test, 80 to 2,000 MHz at 25 V/m. Pass if there is no degradation of the lamp functions at any frequency.

requirements.text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method of Annex 9, the rear combination lamp ESA shall withstand a test level of 21 V/m in the LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency range over more than 90 per cent of the band (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test, LUF to 2,000 MHz at 21 V/m. Pass if there is no degradation of the lamp functions over more than 90 per cent of the band.

requirements.text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method of Annex 9, the rear combination lamp ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 18 V/m over the whole LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test, LUF to 2,000 MHz at 18 V/m. Pass if there is no degradation of the lamp functions at any frequency.

requirements.text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method of Annex 9, the rear combination lamp ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 6 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz at 6 V/m. Pass if there is no degradation of the lamp functions at any frequency.

requirements.text: During the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of the immunity related functions of the rear combination lamp ESA.
requirements.test_case: Monitor each lamp function during all Annex 9 exposures. Pass if there is no unintended switching on or off, no flicker and no change of light output for the position, stop and reversing functions.

requirements.text: The starting profile test of the rear combination lamp shall be evaluated according to the functional status classification defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 starting profile test; pass if the lamp behaviour is classified per ISO 16750-1 and meets the Table 3a status.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) of ISO 7637-1 shall be applied to the rear combination lamp for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 pulse tests; pass if the lamp behaviour is classified per ISO 7637-1 FPSC and meets the Table 3b class.

requirements.text: If the lamp may be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12 V/24 V starter motor, the rear combination lamp functions related to immunity related functions (e.g. stop lamp) that shall be operational during engine start phases shall meet functional status B when subjected to the starting profile at immunity test level II (12 V and 24 V systems) with 10 pulses.
requirements.test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile, level II, 10 pulses, per Annex 10; pass if functional status B per ISO 16750-1.

requirements.text: If the lamp may be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12 V/24 V starter motor, the rear combination lamp functions related to immunity related functions that need not be operational during engine start phases shall meet functional status C when subjected to the starting profile at immunity test level II with 10 pulses.
requirements.test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile, level II, 10 pulses; pass if functional status C per ISO 16750-1.

requirements.text: If the lamp may be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12 V/24 V starter motor, the rear combination lamp functions not related to immunity related functions shall meet functional status D when subjected to the starting profile at immunity test level II with 10 pulses.
requirements.test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile, level II, 10 pulses; pass if functional status D per ISO 16750-1.

requirements.text: When subjected to test pulse 1 at -75 V (12 V system) or -450 V (24 V system) for 500 pulses, the rear combination lamp shall meet FPSC class III, both for functions related and not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 1, -75 V/-450 V, 500 pulses per Annex 10; pass if FPSC III per ISO 7637-1.

requirements.text: When subjected to test pulse 2a at +37 V (12 V and 24 V systems) for 500 pulses, the rear combination lamp functions related to immunity related functions shall meet FPSC class I.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 2a, +37 V, 500 pulses; pass if FPSC I (function performs as designed during and after test).

requirements.text: When subjected to test pulse 2b at +10 V (12 V system) or +20 V (24 V system) for 10 pulses, the rear combination lamp functions related to immunity related functions shall meet FPSC class II.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 2b, +10 V/+20 V, 10 pulses; pass if FPSC II.

requirements.text: When subjected to test pulse 3a at -112 V (12 V system) or -150 V (24 V system) for a test duration of 1 h, the rear combination lamp functions related to immunity related functions shall meet FPSC class I.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 3a, -112 V/-150 V, 1 h; pass if FPSC I.

requirements.text: When subjected to test pulse 3b at +75 V (12 V system) or +150 V (24 V system) for a test duration of 1 h, the rear combination lamp functions not related to immunity related functions shall meet FPSC class III.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 3b, +75 V/+150 V, 1 h; pass if FPSC III.

requirements.text: Where the ESA (rear combination lamp, including its LED driver electronics) does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.6.2. and with Annex 8 (radiated narrowband emissions).
requirements.test_case: Design review of the circuit diagram and bill of materials to confirm there is no oscillator, PWM controller, switching regulator or microcontroller clock above 9 kHz. If confirmed, document the exemption from the paragraph 6.6.2. / Annex 8 narrowband test. Otherwise, test according to Annex 8 against the paragraph 6.6.2. limits.

requirements.text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
requirements.test_case: Design review to establish whether the lamp is switched, contains switches or includes an inductive load (e.g. switching-regulator inductors). If none applies, document the exemption from the paragraph 6.7. transient conducted emission test. Otherwise, test the 12/24 V supply lines against the paragraph 6.7. limits.

requirements.text: When measured according to paragraph 6.5.2.1. or 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the ESA (rear combination lamp electronics) in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall not exceed the limit E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
requirements.test_case: Broadband radiated emission measurement per Annex 7 (ESA, 120 kHz bandwidth) across 30-75 MHz with lamp functions energised; pass if all measured values are at or below 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: When measured according to paragraph 6.5.2.1. or 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the ESA (rear combination lamp electronics) in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall not exceed the limit E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
requirements.test_case: Broadband radiated emission measurement per Annex 7 (ESA, 120 kHz bandwidth) across 75-400 MHz with lamp functions energised; pass if all measured values are at or below 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: When measured according to paragraph 6.5.2.1. or 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the ESA (rear combination lamp electronics) in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall not exceed the constant limit E = 63 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
requirements.test_case: Broadband radiated emission measurement per Annex 7 (ESA, 120 kHz bandwidth) across 400-1,000 MHz with lamp functions energised; pass if all measured values are at or below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: When measured according to paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation, the narrowband radiated emissions of the ESA (rear combination lamp electronics) in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall not exceed the limit E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
requirements.test_case: ESA narrowband radiated emission measurement per paragraph 6.6.2.1. / Annex 8 method, 120 kHz bandwidth, 30-75 MHz; pass if measured level <= 52 - 25.13 log(F/30) dBµV/m at every frequency

requirements.text: When measured according to paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation, the narrowband radiated emissions of the ESA (rear combination lamp electronics) in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall not exceed the limit E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
requirements.test_case: ESA narrowband radiated emission measurement per paragraph 6.6.2.1. / Annex 8 method, 120 kHz bandwidth, 75-400 MHz; pass if measured level <= 42 + 15.13 log(F/75) dBµV/m at every frequency

requirements.text: When measured according to paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation, the narrowband radiated emissions of the ESA (rear combination lamp electronics) in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall not exceed the constant limit E = 53 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
requirements.test_case: ESA narrowband radiated emission measurement per paragraph 6.6.2.1. / Annex 8 method, 120 kHz bandwidth, 400-1,000 MHz; pass if measured level <= 53 dBµV/m at every frequency

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp (ESA) under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report: all lamp functions are energised at nominal supply voltage, preferably all simultaneously at maximum load, during the whole 30-1,000 MHz measurement.

requirements.text: The broadband emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Scan 30-1,000 MHz in an ALSE or OATS; pass if emissions are at or below the para. 6.5 limits across the whole range.

requirements.text: If peak detectors are used for the broadband emission measurement of the rear combination lamp, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied to the quasi-peak limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10.
requirements.test_case: Review evaluation: peak readings compared against the quasi-peak limit with the 20 dB CISPR 12 correction applied; quasi-peak readings compared directly against the limit.

requirements.text: During the narrowband emission test, the rear combination lamp ESA shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Check the test set-up record. Pass: the lamp functions are energised in normal operation, preferably with all functions (position, stop and reversing) on at maximum load.

requirements.text: The narrowband radiated emissions of the rear combination lamp ESA shall comply with the limits throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an ALSE or OATS.
requirements.test_case: Perform a radiated emission scan from 30 to 1,000 MHz per Annex 8. Pass: the emissions are below the para. 6.6.2.1 narrowband limits across the whole range.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission measurements of the rear combination lamp ESA shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Check the instrument settings. Pass: the average detector is selected.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods, at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that the results cover the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of Annex 9: absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2, TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3, bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4, stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5, and reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Review the test plan and reports to confirm that the chosen ISO 11452-2/-3/-4/-5/-11 methods together cover 20 to 6,000 MHz. Pass: the full range is covered with no gaps.

requirements.text: For the immunity tests of the rear combination lamp ESA, the frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test setup and report against ISO 11452-1. Pass: the frequency range and general conditions conform.

requirements.text: Immunity measurements of the rear combination lamp ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Sweep 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 step sizes. Pass: no malfunction of the lamp functions.

requirements.text: In the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Verify the signal generator settings for 20 to 400 MHz: AM, 1 kHz, 80 % depth. Pass: the settings are applied and the ESA functions remain unaffected.

requirements.text: In the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Verify the generator settings for 2,700 to 3,100 MHz: PM, Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs. Pass: the settings are applied and there is no malfunction.

requirements.text: In the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Verify the generator settings for 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz: PM, Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs. Pass: the settings are applied and there is no malfunction.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test software's step and dwell settings against ISO 11452-1. Pass: they conform.

requirements.text: As an alternative to bench BCI testing, the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4, using the BCI substitution method with the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: For an in-vehicle BCI test per ISO 11451-4, verify the substitution method with the probe at 150 mm from the ESA. Pass: no malfunction.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be immune to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply.
requirements.test_case: Test per Annex 10 paragraph 2 (ISO 7637-2 pulses and ISO 16750-2 starting profile); lamp functions show no unacceptable degradation.

requirements.text: Conducted transients from the rear combination lamp ESA to the vehicle power supply shall be limited.
requirements.test_case: Measurement per Annex 10 paragraph 3 (ISO 7637-2) on supply lines; emitted transients within the limits of the Regulation.

requirements.text: Test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the 12/24 V supply lines as well as to other connections of the rear combination lamp ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b applied to each supply-connected input (e.g. tail, stop, reverse feeds) with lamp operating; functions remain within the immunity performance criteria.

requirements.text: The starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the 12/24 V supply lines as well as to other connections of the rear combination lamp ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines (unless the ESA is exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor).
requirements.test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile applied to supply-connected inputs with lamp operating; functions remain within the immunity performance criteria. For an M1 lamp not exclusively reserved for electric vehicles, this test applies.

requirements.text: Every rear combination lamp belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Drawing review and visual inspection of the sample: a marking area is reserved that accommodates the approval marking and all markings of paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.

requirements.text: All markings on the rear combination lamp shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual check for legibility, plus a durability check (e.g. rubbing with water- and solvent-soaked cloth): markings remain legible and not removed.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the dimension "a" of the approval marking (arrangement per Annex 7): a >= 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: circle surrounding "E" followed by the country distinguishing number is present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2., placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: 4- to 6-digit sequential number present and located close to the approval mark; matches the approval number.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4. for the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector functions.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection against paragraph 3.2.4.: a correct identification symbol is present for each approved function.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: "148R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments in force at the time of approval.

requirements.text: As the rear combination lamp is a handed unit which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of both left- and right-hand units: horizontal mounting arrow present.

requirements.text: For the rear position lamp, the horizontal mounting arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the arrow direction on the lamp in its installed orientation: arrow points outwards from the vehicle.

requirements.text: If the reversing lamp has reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps, the horizontal mounting arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: If approved with reduced light distribution: check the arrow in installed orientation points outwards from the vehicle.

requirements.text: If the lamp may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps, the additional letter "D" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: If applicable: visual inspection shows "D" to the right of the relevant function symbol.

requirements.text: If the lamp is used as part of an interdependent lamps system, the additional letter "Y" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: If applicable: visual inspection shows "Y" to the right of the relevant function symbol.

requirements.text: If a lamp function has reduced light distribution (see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3), the approval marking shall include a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
requirements.test_case: If approved with reduced light distribution: visual inspection shows the downward vertical arrow from a horizontal segment.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: approval marking present on the lamp.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: trade name or mark of the applicant present.

requirements.text: As the lamp has non-replaceable light sources and/or an electronic light source control gear, it shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: rated voltage (e.g. 12V) or voltage range marked on the lamp.

requirements.text: If replaceable light source module(s) are used, each light source module shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: If applicable: visual inspection of the module for the applicant trade name or mark.

requirements.text: If replaceable light source module(s) are used, each module shall bear its specific identification code, comprising the starting letters "MD" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1., followed by additional symbols or characters in case several non-identical light source modules are used; the module approval mark and the lamp approval mark shall be from the same applicant.
requirements.test_case: If applicable: visual inspection of the code format "MD" + approval mark without circle (+ distinguishing characters for non-identical modules); verify same applicant as lamp.

requirements.text: If replaceable light source module(s) are used, each module shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: If applicable: visual inspection of the voltage marking on the module.

requirements.text: If replaceable light source module(s) are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.test_case: If applicable: visual inspection that the module code is marked on the lamp.

requirements.text: If replaceable light source module(s) are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: If applicable: visual inspection of the voltage marking on the lamp.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: If applicable: visual inspection of the external unit for identification number and manufacturer name.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Drawing review and inspection: marking is on a part permanently joined to the light-emitting outer lens.

requirements.text: The approval marking, as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: Inspection on vehicle or installation mock-up: marking visible with lamp fitted or with boot lid/door opened.

requirements.text: If the outer lens is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: If the outer lens is detachable: visual inspection shows the approval marking on both lens and housing.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: all listed markings are affixed on the lamp itself.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number is affixed to the combined lamp complying with several UN Regulations, it shall be visible after installation.
requirements.test_case: Inspection on vehicle or mock-up: single approval mark visible after installation.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is used, no part of the combined lamp that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Design review and disassembly check: removing any light-transmitting part also removes the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure mark components and compare with the minimum sizes of each applicable UN Regulation (e.g. R148, R150): not less than the minimum of the smallest individual mark.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulation No. 48, and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval, shall apply to the rear combination lamp intended for installation on M1 vehicles, where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp design and drawings against UN R48 sections 5 and 6 and referenced Annexes, using the series of amendments in force at application. Check every requirement that can be verified at lamp type approval, e.g. geometric visibility angles, apparent surface and colour. Pass if all such requirements are met.

requirements.text: The requirements of UN Regulation No. 48 sections 5 and 6 pertinent to the rear position lamp and to vehicle category M1 shall be applied to the rear position lamp function, where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check the rear position lamp's geometric visibility and red colour against the UN R48 individual specification for rear position lamps on M1. Check the illuminating surface and orientation of the handed unit, with the opposite-side unit presumed mirrored. Pass if compliant.

requirements.text: The requirements of UN Regulation No. 48 sections 5 and 6 pertinent to the stop lamp and to vehicle category M1 shall be applied to the stop lamp function, where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check the stop lamp's geometric visibility angles and red colour against the UN R48 individual specification for stop lamps (S1/S2) on M1 vehicles. Pass if compliant.

requirements.text: The requirements of UN Regulation No. 48 sections 5 and 6 pertinent to the reversing lamp and to vehicle category M1 shall be applied to the reversing lamp function, where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check the reversing lamp's geometric visibility angles and white colour against the UN R48 individual specification for reversing lamps on M1 vehicles. Pass if compliant.

requirements.text: The lamps (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions of the rear combination lamp) shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured.
requirements.test_case: Design review plus vibration/durability test representative of vehicle use (e.g. per OEM vibration profile); after exposure, all functions (rear position, stop, reversing) operate correctly with no LED failure, intermittent contact, loosened fasteners or mechanical damage.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: After vibration/durability exposure, repeat photometric and colorimetric measurements per UN R148 requirements; intensities and colour coordinates remain within the prescribed limits for each function.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, these functions shall either (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Design review of the LED/PCB circuit: confirm that the rear position and stop functions use separate light sources, or that the lamp is intended for a vehicle with a failure tell-tale; pass if either condition is met.

requirements.text: If a manufacturer logo is incorporated in the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside the apparent surface of a lamp function, only one logo shall be incorporated, and all requirements of this Regulation for that specific function shall be fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection for the number of logos; photometric and colorimetric tests of the function with the logo per this Regulation; pass if there is one logo and all function requirements are met.

requirements.text: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer shall be incorporated in the lamp's optical components or outer lens.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the logo against the vehicle or body manufacturer brand; pass if it is only that brand logo.

requirements.text: The enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projected enclosed logo area in the direction of the reference axis; pass if it is ≤ 100 cm2.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the stop lamp apparent surface (optical components and outer lens); pass if no logo is present.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the reversing lamp apparent surface (optical components and outer lens window); pass if no logo is present.

requirements.text: In the rear combination lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review the circuit diagram and PCB layout to identify LED groups wired in series or with common failure behaviour. Disconnect one LED per group and verify that the whole group extinguishes. Pass: each such group is treated as one light source in the failure analysis of paragraph 4.6.1.2.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in the rear position lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3, and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraph 6.10.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced.
requirements.test_case: Option (a): simulate failure of each single light source (or group per paragraph 4.6.1.1.) in turn and measure on a goniophotometer at the Annex 3 grid points. Pass: all minimum intensities are met; with all sources lit, no maximum is exceeded. Option (b): verify that a failure signal is produced for each single failure. Pass: signal is produced and the communication form notes tell-tale-only use.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2, in case of failure of the variable intensity control resulting in emission of more than the maximum value of category R1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control (e.g. open or short of the control input or driver fault) and measure the luminous intensity. Pass: the lamp automatically reverts to intensities meeting the steady-intensity requirements of category R1.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S4, in case of failure of the variable intensity control resulting in emission of more than the maximum value of category S3, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and perform photometric measurement. Pass: intensities automatically fall within the steady-intensity requirements of category S3.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128 (provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval), and/or light source module(s), and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Design review and inspection of the sample against the bill of materials: each light source is identified as a UN R37/R99/R128 approved replaceable source without use restriction, a light source module or a non-replaceable source; pass if no other type is fitted.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: EMC testing of radiated and conducted (power line) emissions, assessed at vehicle type level (e.g. per UN R10); pass if no malfunction of other vehicle electric/electronic systems is caused.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
requirements.test_case: Fitting trial in all possible positions and orientations; pass if the module can only be fitted in the designated correct position.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module shall be such that it can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Attempt removal of the module by hand without tools; pass if removal is only possible with tool(s).

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall be tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspection and tamper attempt on the module; pass if the module cannot be opened or altered without evident damage.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
requirements.test_case: Interchangeability trial with UN approved replaceable light sources in the module interface and vice versa, with and without tools; pass if no interchange is possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Cross-fitting trial of each module into the other module positions of the same housing, with and without tools; pass if modules with different characteristics cannot be interchanged.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the rear combination lamp shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace the module with another sample bearing the same identification code and repeat the photometric measurements of UN R148; pass if all photometric requirements are met.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Supply 13.5 V for a 12 V system (or 6.75 V / 28 V as applicable) at the lamp connector during photometry; pass if the voltage is maintained.

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lamp with the control gear and settings declared by the applicant during photometry; pass if the operation matches the declaration.

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control and equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Operate at the applicant-specified supply conditions during photometry; pass if the operation matches the declaration.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples on the reference axis (HV) shall be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Annex 3/Annex 8 photometry of both samples at HV; pass if intensity ≥ the paragraph 5 minimum for each function.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples shall in no direction where the lamp is visible exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric scan of both samples over the visible field; pass if no value exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, outside the reference axis the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples shall be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5 by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3, or not less than the intensity value specified in that light distribution figure, for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure at each grid point of the Annex 3 light distribution figure; pass if each value ≥ the minimum × percentage, or ≥ the specified value.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples shall be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure over the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles; pass if all values ≥ the paragraph 5 minimum.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Visual check and intermediate measurements between grid points per Annex 3; pass if the local variation criteria are met.

requirements.text: If the applicant requests the additional test, the maximum intensity in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction shall be not more than 2.5∙10-1 cd, in order to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear required in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Optional measurement over H 165°–180° outboard and V -2.5° to +5°, optionally including the vehicle body influence; pass if max ≤ 0.25 cd.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, the ratio between the luminous intensities measured with both lamps on simultaneously and with the rear position lamp on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by ±5° V and ±10° H of the light distribution table; where either lamp contains more than one light source and is considered a single lamp, the values shall be obtained with all sources in operation.
requirements.test_case: Measure grid points within ±5° V / ±10° H with stop + position lamps on, then with the position lamp alone, all sources operating; pass if the ratio is ≥ 5:1 at each point.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid defined in Annex 3, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed for the light emitted by each lamp function.
requirements.test_case: Visual/colorimetric inspection of emitted light outside the Annex 3 grid field for each function; pass if no sharp colour variation is observed.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp supplied shall meet the luminous intensity requirements of Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1; pass if all Table 4 values for the declared category (R1 or R2) are met on each sample.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 4∙10^0 cd.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (a) at reference axis; pass if intensity ≥ 4 cd.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady) and is used as a single lamp, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 1.7∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b) in all directions; pass if no value exceeds 17 cd (except as permitted for reciprocal incorporation with stop lamp).

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady) and is marked "D" (paragraph 3.3.2.5.2.), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 8.5∙10^0 cd.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no value exceeds 8.5 cd.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 4∙10^0 cd.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if intensity ≥ 4 cd.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable) and is used as a single lamp, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 4.2∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no value exceeds 42 cd.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable) and is marked "D" (paragraph 3.3.2.5.2.), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.1∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no value exceeds 21 cd.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp (R1 or R2) shall meet the standard light distribution defined in Figure A3-I and Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Photometric grid measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (c), Figure A3-I / Table A2-1; pass if each grid point meets the prescribed percentage of the minimum intensity.

requirements.text: Within the angles of geometric visibility (paragraph 4.8.3.1 (d)), the rear position lamp (R1 or R2) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 5∙10^-2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement over the full geometric visibility field; pass if intensity ≥ 0.05 cd in all directions.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement below 5° down; pass if intensity ≤ 60 cd there and Table 4 maximum is met elsewhere.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the red boundaries defined in the regulation.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per para. 4.8.3.1; pass if each sample meets all applicable Table 7 values for its category.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement on the reference axis per para. 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if intensity ≥ 60 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady) and used as a single lamp, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.60∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement over the light distribution per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no intensity > 260 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady) and is a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 1.30∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no intensity > 130 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady), the light distribution shall comply with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)).
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities at the grid points of Figure A3-I per para. 4.8.3.1 (c); pass if each point meets the prescribed percentage of the minimum intensity.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady), the luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be not less than 3∙10^-1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)).
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity throughout the geometric visibility field of Table A2-1 per para. 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if all values ≥ 0.3 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if intensity ≥ 60 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable) and used as a single lamp, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 7.30∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no intensity > 730 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable) and is a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 3.65∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no intensity > 365 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable), the light distribution shall comply with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)).
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities at the grid points of Figure A3-I per para. 4.8.3.1 (c); pass if each point meets the prescribed percentage.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable), the luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be not less than 3∙10^-1 cd for day condition.
requirements.test_case: Measure in day mode throughout the Table A2-1 field per para. 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if all values ≥ 0.3 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable), the luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be not less than 7∙10^-2 cd for night condition.
requirements.test_case: Measure in night mode throughout the Table A2-1 field per para. 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if all values ≥ 0.07 cd.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light through the outer lens; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the red boundaries defined in the regulation.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp (category AR) shall meet the requirements in Table 10, with the standard light distribution as defined in Figure A3-V.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1 at the Figure A3-V grid points; pass if all Table 10 values are met.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp of category AR shall emit a minimum luminous intensity of 8.0∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if the minimum luminous intensity is ≥ 80 cd where required.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR shall not exceed 3.00∙10^2 cd in or above the H-plane.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b) over all directions in or above the H-plane; pass if maximum ≤ 300 cd.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR shall not exceed 6.00∙10^2 cd below the H-plane down to 5°D.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b) from H-plane down to 5°D; pass if maximum ≤ 600 cd.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR shall not exceed 8.00∙10^3 cd below 5°D.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b) below 5°D; pass if maximum ≤ 8,000 cd.

requirements.text: If the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.test_case: If pair-only approval is applied for: measure luminous intensity at 30° inwards; pass if ≥ 25 cd.

requirements.text: If the reversing lamp is approved under the pair-only condition, the device shall only be installed on the vehicle in a pair.
requirements.test_case: Inspect vehicle installation against communication form paragraph 9.1.3; pass if reversing lamps are fitted as a pair.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Verify failure behaviour per paragraph 4.6 (e.g. simulated LED failure); pass if paragraph 4.6 requirements are met.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light per colour specification of the regulation; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the white boundaries.

requirements.text: For conformity of production, no measured value of the rear position, stop or reversing lamp shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of production samples per Annexes 4 and 5; pass if every measured value is within an unfavourable deviation of 20 per cent of the prescribed value.

requirements.text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, where the required minimum value is 7∙10-1 cd, the measured value shall be not less than 5∙10-1 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) or 3∙10-1 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as per Table 12.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement across the Annex 2/3 fields per Annexes 4 and 5; pass if the measured value is ≥ 5∙10-1 cd (20 per cent level) or ≥ 3∙10-1 cd (30 per cent level).

requirements.text: The angles of geometric visibility of Annex 2 are those for lamps to be mounted on the right side of the vehicle; the handed rear combination lamp for the opposite (left) side shall meet the same angles in the mirrored arrangement.
requirements.test_case: Design and drawing review of both handed units against Annex 2 Figures A2-I. Pass if the inboard and outboard directions are correctly assigned for each side.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 80° outboard.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check of the apparent surface per Annex 2 Figures A2-I, on drawings or with a goniometer. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 45° inboard to 80° outboard.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp (R1, R2) is mounted with its H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 80° outboard may be used, but only below the H-plane.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the installed H-plane height is below 750 mm. Check visibility below the H-plane. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from at least 20° inboard to 80° outboard.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above / 15° below the H-plane.
requirements.test_case: Vertical geometric visibility check per Annex 2 Figures A2-I. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 15° above to 15° below the H-plane.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp (R1, R2) is to be installed with its H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles shall be 15° above / 5° below the H-plane.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the mounting height is less than 750 mm. Check visibility. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 15° above to 5° below the H-plane.

requirements.text: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 45° outboard.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check of the apparent surface per Annex 2 Figures A2-I. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 45° inboard to 45° outboard.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp (S1, S2) is mounted with its H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 45° outboard may be used, but only below the H-plane.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the H-plane height is below 750 mm. Check visibility below the H-plane. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from at least 20° inboard to 45° outboard.

requirements.text: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above / 15° below the H-plane.
requirements.test_case: Vertical geometric visibility check per Annex 2 Figures A2-I. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 15° above to 15° below the H-plane.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp (S1, S2) is to be installed with its H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles shall be 15° above / 5° below the H-plane.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the mounting height is less than 750 mm. Check visibility. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 15° above to 5° below the H-plane.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp shall have their direction H = 0° and V = 0° corresponding to the reference axis, which on the vehicle is horizontal, parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, oriented in the required direction of visibility and passing through the centre of reference.
requirements.test_case: Review the drawing and mounting data: the reference axis passes through the declared centre of reference and is horizontal and parallel to the vehicle median longitudinal plane in the installed position. Pass if consistent.

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the minimum intensities for the various directions of measurement shall be the percentages shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV of the minimum intensities required, mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement at each grid point. Compute each point limit as the figure percentage times the required minimum intensity, rounded down to three significant digits. Pass if every measured value is at least its limit.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is intended to be installed at a mounting height equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer), the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the declared mounting height of the H plane. If it is ≤ 750 mm, verify the photometric grid only down to V = -5°. Pass if all points from V = -5° upwards meet their minima.

requirements.text: Where the stop lamp of category S1, S2 or MS is intended to be installed at a mounting height equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer), the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the declared mounting height of the H plane. If it is ≤ 750 mm, verify the stop lamp grid only down to V = -5°. Pass if all points from V = -5° upwards meet their minima.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value shown, as a percentage, on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric scan between the grid points. Pass if every intermediate direction is at least the lowest minimum of the surrounding grid points.

requirements.text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of the lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement shall be below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: First examine the lit lamp visually. If substantial local variations appear, measure the intensity between adjacent grid directions of Figure A3-V. Pass if each value is at least 50 % of the lower of the two prescribed minima.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities given as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (Table 3) according to the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Measure on a goniophotometer at the Figure A3-I grid points. Pass if each point is at least its percentage of the Table 3 minimum.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of category S1, S2 or MS shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities given as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (Table 7) according to the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Measure on a goniophotometer at the Figure A3-I grid points. Pass if each point is at least its percentage of the Table 7 minimum.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit, at the measuring points of Figure A3-V (expressed in degrees of angle with the axis of reference), at least the minimum intensities in cd shown in Figure A3-V.
requirements.test_case: Measure on a goniophotometer at each Figure A3-V point relative to the reference axis. Pass if each value in cd is at least the value shown in the figure.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performances, any mass-produced lamp chosen at random shall meet the photometric requirements when tested according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of a randomly selected production lamp per paragraph 4.8.; pass if the photometric requirements of the Regulation are met for each function.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of the light emitted by the mass-produced lamp shall be complied with when tested under the conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of production samples per paragraph 4.9.; pass if the chromaticity coordinates fall within the prescribed colour boundaries for each function.

requirements.text: For the reversing lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements. The luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes may be calculated from the distribution measured after photometric stability by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 minute, after 10 minutes and after photometric stability.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 para 1.2.1: operate reversing function and measure luminous intensity at 1 min and at 10 min, or measure the full distribution at photometric stability and scale it using HV ratios at 1 min and 10 min. Pass: all test points within the minimum and maximum values at both times.

requirements.text: For the rear position lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements. The distribution after 1 min may be calculated from the distribution after 30 min or after photometric stabilization by applying at each test point the HV intensity ratio.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 para 1.2.2: operate rear position function and measure at 1 min and at 30 min or photometric stability, or scale the full distribution using HV ratios. Pass: all test points within the minimum and maximum values at both times.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflective device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier and the other markings defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2., or for the approval marking and the other markings defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Drawing review and sample inspection: confirm a dedicated marking area large enough for the UI (or approval marking) plus the 3.3.4.2 markings at the size required by Table 1.

requirements.text: All markings on the retro-reflective device shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual check at normal reading distance for legibility. Indelibility check, e.g. rubbing with a cloth soaked in water and then in fuel/solvent; markings must remain legible.

requirements.text: The size of the approval marking shall comply with the value for "a" defined in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the dimensions of the approval mark components against the value of "a" in Table 1. Use the Annex 10 examples as the arrangement reference.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the marking against the approval documents: the circle with "E" and the correct country number must be present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: the sequential number must match the approval number and have 4 to 6 digits.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the layout: the sequential number must be adjacent to the E-circle, as in the Annex 10 examples.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: the class symbol(s) of the retro-reflector (e.g. IA or IB) must be present and match the approval.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: "150R" followed by the correct series-of-amendments digits (e.g. 00) must be present.

requirements.text: If the approval marking is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format of Figure I of paragraph 3.3.3.1.
requirements.test_case: Visual comparison of the UI mark with Figure I. The UI number must match the entry in the UN secure internet database.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: the applicant's trade name or mark must be present and legible.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word "TOP" shall be inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Review the retro-reflector's rotational symmetry and the mounting orientation specified by the manufacturer. If orientation is ambiguous, verify that "TOP" is horizontal at the highest part of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraph 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the sample: all required markings must be legible on the device itself.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed to the combined lamp, the marking shall be visible after installation on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Install the lamp in the vehicle or a representative fixture and confirm the single marking is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is used, no part of the combined lamp that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.test_case: Design review and disassembly check: each light-transmitting part (outer lens, reversing insert, retro-reflector) must be inseparable from the part carrying the marking.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mark components and compare them with the minimum sizes required by each applicable Regulation (e.g. R148, R150). Pass if each component is at least the minimum required for the smallest individual mark.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall meet the requirements contained in section 5 "General specifications" of UN Regulation No. 48, and the Annexes referenced in that section, in the series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval, as pertinent to the retro-reflecting device and to vehicle category M1, where verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device and its installation drawings against UN R48 section 5 and the referenced Annexes for M1. Pass if every pertinent requirement that can be verified at device approval is met.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall meet the individual specifications for this device in section 6 of UN Regulation No. 48, and the Annexes referenced in that section, in the series of amendments in force at the time of application for type approval. These specifications cover presence, number, arrangement, position (width, height, length), geometric visibility, orientation and other requirements, as pertinent to vehicle category M1. They apply where verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check the drawings and the device against the UN R48 section 6 provisions for rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular: mounting height and lateral position, geometric visibility angles and orientation for M1. Pass if all requirements that can be verified at device approval are met.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be so constructed that it functions satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Design review and inspection of samples after the R150 annex tests (e.g. heat, water, dust, corrosion resistance); pass if the retro-reflector still meets photometric and colour requirements.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to its efficient operation or to its maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Visual and design inspection of production samples; pass if no defects affecting operation or maintenance are found.

requirements.text: The components of the retro-reflector or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
