requirements.test_case: Attempt manual disassembly without tools; pass if retro-reflector components cannot be easily separated.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall be easy to clean.
requirements.test_case: Visual and tactile inspection plus cleaning trial with cloth; pass if surface is easily cleaned.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not be rough and any protuberances it may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Visual and tactile inspection of the outer surface; pass if not rough and protuberances do not hinder cleaning.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflector when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the mounted assembly; pass if the inner (reflecting) surface cannot be reached without dismantling the lamp.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, it shall be so designed that the optical unit and filter cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: Design review and manual separation attempt under normal-use conditions; pass if optical unit and filter remain inseparable.

requirements.text: The retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.
requirements.test_case: Material/process documentation review and visual inspection; pass if colour is obtained from coloured material, not paint or varnish.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the red retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0°, or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric test per R150 para. 4.2.1.2: check that the set-up uses CIE Standard Illuminant A, 1/3° divergence and β1 = β2 = 0°. If a colourless surface reflection occurs, check that the alternative angle per Annex 4, Part 1, para. 1.1 is used. Pass: the test conditions are documented as specified.

requirements.text: When illuminated as specified in paragraph 4.2.1.2, the trichromatic coordinates of the luminous intensity reflected by the retro-reflective device shall be within the limits for the night-time colour (red) of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates x, y of the retro-reflected light under CIE Illuminant A, 1/3° divergence, β1 = β2 = 0° (or the Annex 4 Part 1 para. 1.1 angle). Pass: x, y lie within the red night-time colour boundaries defined in UN R48.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection and measurement against Annex 5 on all ten samples at the start of the Table 4 sequence; pass if shape and dimensions conform to Annex 5.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 and colorimetry per paragraph 4.2.1.; pass if RI values meet Table 3 (red) and colour is within the R48 night-time red limits.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Run the Table 4 test sequence (heat, water, fuels, oils, corrosion, rear face, stability in time, weathering); pass if all tests are passed with subsequent colour and RI compliance.

requirements.text: After the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6, and at least one hour after this test, the retro-reflector shall meet the colorimetric characteristics of paragraph 5.1.5. and the RI of paragraph 5.1.4. for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° (or, if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.).
requirements.test_case: Heat all ten samples 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C, wait ≥1 h, measure colour and RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if colour within red limits and RI ≥ 300 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum RI values after the heat test shall meet the complete photometric requirements of paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Complete photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 on min and max samples; pass if all Table 3 red values for Class IA/IB are met.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall pass the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) followed by the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
requirements.test_case: First group of two samples: water penetration then motor fuels and oils; pass if visual inspection satisfactory and subsequent colour and RI (20', β1 = β2 = 0°) comply.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall, if necessary, pass the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6 and then the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Second group of two samples: corrosion then rear face abrasion; pass if visual inspection satisfactory and subsequent colour and RI comply.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall pass the test for stability in time of the optical properties of the retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Third group of two samples per Part 3 of Annex 4; pass if subsequent colour and RI (20', β1 = β2 = 0°) comply.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall pass the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
requirements.test_case: Fourth group of two samples per Part 6 of Annex 6; pass if subsequent colour and RI (20', β1 = β2 = 0°) comply.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetry per paragraph 4.2. (visual, trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt) after each test group; pass if within R48 night-time red limits.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., verified only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 at α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0° after each group; pass if RI ≥ 300 mcd/lx (red).

requirements.text: Where more than one or a range of different axes of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the retro-reflector shall meet the photometric requirements with reference to each axis of reference or to the extreme axes of reference of the range specified.
requirements.test_case: Repeat photometric measurements for each declared axis / extreme axes of the range; pass if Table 3 values are met each time.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' and illumination angle β1 = 0°, β2 = 0° shall be equal to or greater than 3.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4; pass if RI ≥ 300 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 1°30' and illumination angle β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20° shall be equal to or greater than 2.5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4; pass if RI ≥ 2.5 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: RI values of the red retro-reflector lower than those shown in the last applicable column of Table 3 (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°) are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.test_case: Scan photometry within the bounded solid angle per Part 1 of Annex 4; pass if RI ≥ 100 mcd/lx at 20' and ≥ 2.5 mcd/lx at 1°30' throughout.

requirements.text: Where the Class IA or IB retro-reflector is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Confirm declared mounting height of H plane; if < 750 mm, verify Table 3 RI values down to 5° below horizontal only.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the luminous flux reflected by the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates per paragraph 4.2.1.; pass if within R48 night-time red limits.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the heat test of Part 1 of Annex 6 for 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C without distortion on visual inspection.
requirements.test_case: All ten samples, 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C; visual inspection for distortion; pass if no distortion and subsequent colour and RI comply.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the water test of 10 min in normal position and 10 min in inverted position, followed by visual inspection, colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Two samples, 10 min normal + 10 min inverted; pass if no water penetration on visual inspection and colour and RI comply.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand exposure to motor fuels for 5 min (Part 1 of Annex 7) and to oils for 5 min (Part 2 of Annex 7), followed by visual inspection, colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Two samples, 5 min motor fuels then 5 min oils; pass if visual inspection satisfactory and colour and RI comply.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the corrosion test of Part 4 of Annex 6 (24 hours, 2 hours interval, 24 hours) and the rear face test of 1 min, followed by visual inspection, colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Two samples, corrosion 24 h + 2 h interval + 24 h, then rear face 1 min; pass if visual inspection satisfactory and colour and RI comply.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is not marked "TOP", with an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', it shall be rotated about its axis of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the device about its reference axis at β = 0°/0° (or the paragraph 5 angle) and α = 20'. Find the minimum-RI position. Pass if this RI ≥ the paragraph 5 value.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is marked "TOP", with an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', it shall be rotated about its axis ±5° and the RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed during this rotation.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the device ±5° about its axis from the TOP position at α = 20' and record RI continuously. Pass if RI ≥ the prescribed value in every position.

requirements.text: For testing the retro-reflection, the retro-reflector shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Verify the source calibration certificate confirms CIE Illuminant A (2856 K).

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of the retro-reflective device of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1. (Classes IIIA and IIIB), from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the retro-reflector's illuminating surface from an observation distance of 10 m. Pass if the shape cannot easily be confused with the equilateral-triangle shape of Class IIIA/IIIB retro-reflectors.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C as the heat resistance test procedure.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 1 para. 1: condition the retro-reflector sample in a dry-atmosphere oven at 65 °C ± 2 °C for 48 consecutive hours; record temperature and duration.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection after Annex 6 Part 1 heat test and cooling; pass if no cracks are visible on the device or its optical component.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection after Annex 6 Part 1 heat test and cooling; pass if no appreciable distortion of the device or its optical component is visible.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector, being part of a lamp, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para. 1.1: remove removable parts, immerse 10 min in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C, top of illuminating surface 20 mm below water surface.

requirements.text: The water immersion test of the retro-reflector shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para. 1.1: repeat 10 min immersion at 50 °C ± 5 °C with device inverted, rear face under about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: After the 50 °C immersions, the retro-reflector sample units shall be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para. 1.1: immediately transfer to water at 25 °C ± 5 °C under the same immersion conditions (both orientations, 10 min).

requirements.text: After the water penetration test, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit; if visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection after Annex 6 Part 2 para. 1.1 immersion sequence; pass: no water visible on the reflecting surface.

requirements.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.4: verify a test duration of 12 h with 12 complete 5/55 min cycles.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be formed in the interior of the device, nor shall one be able to form by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.6: visually inspect the interior for moisture accumulation, then tap and tilt the device; pass if no standing pool of water is present or formed.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be so designed that it retains the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Corrosion test per Annex 6 Part 4 (ISO 9227:2017 saline mist); verify photometric and colorimetric characteristics after test remain within prescribed limits.

requirements.text: Since the retro-reflector is combined with a lamp, the rear combination lamp shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Remove all removable parts; expose to saline mist 24 h, dry 2 h, expose 24 h (total 50 h); sample must complete test cycle for subsequent evaluation.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection immediately after 50 h saline mist test; pass if no excessive corrosion liable to impair efficiency.

requirements.text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9.
requirements.test_case: After corrosion test and 48 h recovery, clean salt deposits, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≥ Table 9 value.

requirements.text: About five minutes after wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually and must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1 para. 1.1(b): visual inspection about 5 min after the fuel wipe. Pass: no apparent surface changes; slight surface cracks are acceptable.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and retro-reflector) shall be so fitted on the vehicle that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which it may be subjected, it retains the characteristics prescribed by UN R48 and enables the vehicle to comply with the requirements of UN R48.
requirements.test_case: Install the lamp on the vehicle or a representative body fixture with production fasteners; perform vibration exposure representative of normal conditions of use (paras 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1., 2.3.10.2.); afterwards verify mounting position, orientation, geometric visibility and photometric/colour characteristics remain within R48 and component Regulation requirements; pass if no loosening, displacement or loss of compliance.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps of the rear combination lamp to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Design review and physical inspection of the mounting: verify positive locating features (pins/clips/fixed fasteners) define a unique installed position and orientation with no free adjustment; apply handling loads and vibration and confirm no change in aim/orientation; pass if lamp cannot be shifted out of its prescribed position without deliberate tool use.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection: with the vehicle on a flat horizontal surface, measure the angle of each function's reference axis relative to the bearing plane; pass if it is parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: For signalling devices other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection: measure the angle between each function's reference axis and the vehicle's median longitudinal plane in plan view; pass if it is parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with when the lamp is fitted to the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Review the manufacturer's fitting instructions and verify by inspection that the installed lamp conforms to them; pass if all instructions are met.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and retro-reflectors on the left- and right-hand side) shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this estimate is to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed positions of the left and right units on the vehicle against the median longitudinal plane using the exterior geometrical form of the lamps; pass if the positions are symmetrical.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the external geometry of the left-hand and mirrored right-hand units (drawings/CAD and physical samples); pass if the units are mirror-symmetrical externally, interior structure excluded.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair (left and right rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and retro-reflectors) shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure the colour of emitted/reflected light of each function on left and right units per the applicable colorimetric method; pass if both units meet the same colorimetric requirements for each function.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function.
requirements.test_case: Perform photometric measurements of each function on left and right units at the prescribed test points; pass if the intensity distributions are substantially identical (unless approved as a matched pair).

requirements.text: In case of rear lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle rear with lamps installed; pass if there are no logos in lamps, or only one lateral logo on each side, or only one central logo.

requirements.text: Logos incorporated in the rear combination lamp that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the lamp; pass if any logo incorporated is exclusively a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the installation requirements for the paired rear combination lamps (rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflectors) set out in the preceding paragraphs shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle drawings and the installed vehicle. Measure the lamp positions relative to the median longitudinal plane, and compare their mounting heights, colours and photometric characteristics. Pass if any deviation from the paired-lamp requirements is limited to what the vehicle's asymmetrical external shape makes unavoidable.

requirements.text: When the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, shall be fulfilled for each function.
requirements.test_case: Installation and conformity review of the lamp on the M1 vehicle against the individual requirements of each function (colour, mounting position, orientation, geometric visibility angles, electrical connection). Pass: every function meets its own requirements while grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated.

requirements.text: The photometric requirements of each lamp function (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp) shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of each function individually with all other functions of the module switched OFF. Pass: luminous intensities meet the values prescribed for that function.

requirements.text: When the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamp are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the stop lamp (and any other reciprocally incorporated function) with the rear position lamp simultaneously switched ON. Pass: colour of each such function remains within its prescribed colour limits.

requirements.text: If the lamp is a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, it shall be installed in such a way that either (a) the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis. These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Geometric evaluation (CAD projection or measurement) of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the outer lens. Pass: projected area of distinct parts ≥ 60 % of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or minimum gap between facing edges of adjacent distinct parts ≤ 75 mm measured perpendicular to the reference axis.

requirements.text: If the lamp is a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d), it shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.; two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces included in the same lamp body and/or having a common outer lens shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.test_case: Review of lamp classification and geometric evaluation per paragraph 5.7.2.1. (60 % area or 75 mm gap criterion). Pass: criterion met and the lamp is not declared/approved as an interdependent lamp system on the basis of separate surfaces in a common housing/outer lens.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear position lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: With the rear position lamp switched ON at the test voltage, measure luminous intensity at reference points, chromaticity and apparent surface over time. Pass if there is no intentional variation (no modulation, flashing, dimming or sequential pattern) except variations permitted under paragraph 5.9.2.

requirements.text: If the photometric characteristics of the rear position lamp, stop lamp or reversing lamp vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: For each variation state the design provides, measure photometry and colour against the applicable device regulation. States include day/night ambient levels and the rear position lamp with the stop lamp ON and OFF. Pass if every state meets the intensity, colour and apparent surface requirements of the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (rear position lamp, stop lamp, red retro-reflector) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level check according to paragraph 5.10.4.1 (Zone 1, transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle, Annex 4). Pass if no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of the vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp of the rear combination lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Geometric or visual check on the vehicle per Annex 4: observer moved throughout Zone 1 in the transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle. Pass if no part of the apparent surface of any red function is directly visible.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamp is switched ON and OFF only simultaneously with the front position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps (if they exist), the side-marker lamps (if they exist) and the rear registration plate lamp, except while one or more of the conditions of paragraph 5.11.1 exist (position lamps switched ON as parking lamps; side-marker lamps flashing with direction indicators; daytime running lamps switched ON; front position lamp function substituted under paragraph 5.12.1).
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level functional check of the lighting switch circuit: operate the position lamp switch and verify that the rear position lamps, front position lamps, end-outline marker lamps, side-marker lamps (if fitted) and rear registration plate lamp all turn ON and OFF together. Repeat with parking lamps, DRL and paragraph 5.12.1 substitution active to confirm only the permitted exceptions occur. Pass: no state in which any of these lamps can be switched ON or OFF independently outside the 5.11.1 exceptions.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates (x,y) of the rear position lamp light with the lamp operating at its rated voltage/current; pass if the coordinates lie within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation's colour definitions.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates (x,y) of the stop lamp light with the lamp operating at its rated voltage/current; pass if the coordinates lie within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation's colour definitions.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates (x,y) of the reversing lamp light; pass if within the white area bounded by y = 0.150 + 0.640 x, y = 0.440, x = 0.500, y = 0.382, y = 0.050 + 0.750 x and x = 0.310.

requirements.text: The colour of the light reflected by the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the retro-reflected light under the standard illuminant according to the retro-reflector colour test procedure; pass if the coordinates lie within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation's colour definitions.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count rear position lamps fitted and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specification for rear position lamps (para. 6.10.2); pass if equal.

requirements.text: The number of stop lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count stop lamps fitted and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specification for stop lamps (para. 6.7.2); pass if equal.

requirements.text: The number of reversing lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count reversing lamps fitted and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specification for reversing lamps (para. 6.4.2); pass if equal.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count rear non-triangular retro-reflectors fitted and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specification for rear retro-reflectors (para. 6.14.2); pass if equal.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use" (fixed position meaning the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not).
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed rest position (locked or not) other than the normal position of use; determine the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis that remains unobscured. Pass: no more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface hidden.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable for the rear position lamp, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Move the movable component to each fixed position where more than 50 per cent of the rear position lamp apparent surface is hidden; verify the additional lamps switch ON automatically and verify by inspection/measurement that they meet the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps. Pass: additional lamps ON and compliant.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp, even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; the rear position lamp shall therefore be operable by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp as installed on the M1 vehicle: with only the light source and/or fuse fitted (no additional wiring, modules or modifications), switch on the rear position lamp function; pass if the lamp operates.

requirements.text: The stop lamp, even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; the stop lamp shall therefore be operable by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp as installed on the M1 vehicle: with only the light source and/or fuse fitted, apply the service brake; pass if the stop lamp operates without any further installation work.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp, even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; the reversing lamp shall therefore be operable by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp as installed on the M1 vehicle: with only the light source and/or fuse fitted, engage reverse gear with the ignition on; pass if the reversing lamp operates without any further installation work.

requirements.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in colour to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of rear position lamp; verify replacement function emits red light within the rear position lamp colour boundaries (R48 / R148 colorimetric requirements). Pass: colour similar (red).

requirements.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in main intensity to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of rear position lamp; photometric measurement of replacement function at H-V and key points. Pass: main intensity similar to the original rear position lamp values.

requirements.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: With replacement active, actuate the replacement device's original function (e.g. braking). Pass: original function operates and meets its photometric requirements.

requirements.text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure with replacement active. Pass: dashboard tell-tale illuminates indicating temporary replacement and need for repair.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 have variable luminous intensity control, they shall respond simultaneously only to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2.
requirements.test_case: Review the control strategy and inputs, then trigger each listed environmental and traffic condition. Pass if both lamps respond simultaneously and only to the conditions in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control are combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, their intensities shall all vary together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity of both functions at several control levels across the full range. Pass if both vary together in the same direction and in a similar proportion.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 have variable luminous intensity control, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of the two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained in the entire intensity range, including throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensities of both lamps simultaneously, at the same measurement point, at steady levels and during transitions across the whole range. Pass if the prescribed stop/position intensity ratio is met at every point.

requirements.text: When the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, and if the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop or reversing function) has, according to its type approval documentation, been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the lamp shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant device or function as it has been approved. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle in constant voltage operating condition as specified by the applicant, measure the voltage at the lamp terminals for each function; pass if the voltage does not exceed the voltage stated in the lamp's type approval documentation.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., for 6 Volt-Systems, the voltage at the terminals of the rear position, stop and reversing lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V by more than 3 per cent, when the vehicle electrical system is in a constant voltage operating condition. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage of each function on the vehicle in constant voltage operating condition; pass if ≤ 6.75 V + 3 per cent.

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp is installed on the vehicle, there shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp to the propagation of light from any part of its apparent surface observed from infinity; obstacles already present when the lamp was type-approved are not taken into account.
requirements.test_case: Installed-vehicle inspection: observe the apparent surface from infinity (or parallel-shifted directions) over the full geometric visibility angles prescribed for the rear position lamp; pass if no vehicle part obstructs light from any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles present at lamp type approval.

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp is installed on the vehicle, there shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility of the retro-reflector to the propagation of light from any part of its apparent surface observed from infinity; obstacles already present when the device was type-approved are not taken into account.
requirements.test_case: Installed-vehicle inspection over the rear retro-reflector geometric visibility angles; pass if no obstruction of any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles present at type approval.

requirements.text: If, when the rear combination lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of a lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of the installed (partially masked) unit or with representative masking; pass if the unmasked part meets all photometric values prescribed for approval of each function.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1.; if below 750 mm and reduction to 5° is applicable, verify photometry of installed unit over field down to 5° below horizontal; pass if prescribed values met in that reduced field.

requirements.text: If an LED module of the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop or reversing function) is not replaceable, this shall be stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval; otherwise the LED module shall be replaceable.
requirements.test_case: Document and design review: compare the replaceability of each LED module in the lamp (removal without destroying the lamp) against the component type approval communication sheet (UN R7/R23 or R148). Pass if each non-replaceable LED module is declared non-replaceable on the communication sheet, or if the module is replaceable.

requirements.text: When installed on a vehicle, the rear position lamp function shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Document check: verify a valid device type approval (UN R148 approval mark for rear position lamp, category R/R1/R2) is held and marked on the lamp before vehicle installation; pass if approval exists and matches the installed device.

requirements.text: When installed on a vehicle, the rear retro-reflector shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Document check: verify a valid device type approval (UN R150 approval mark for rear retro-reflector, class IA or IB) is held and marked on the device; pass if approval exists and matches the installed device.

requirements.text: If the light-signalling lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Design review for presence of a manufacturer logo in the light-emitting surface; if present, verify the UN R148 approval covers the logo configuration; pass if approval to UN R148 including the logo exists.

requirements.text: A reversing lamp shall be mandatorily installed on motor vehicles (including category M1).
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify that at least one reversing lamp function is fitted; pass if present.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device is optional.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count reversing lamp devices; pass if 1 or 2 devices are fitted.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify valid R23 (00 or later series) or R148 (00 or later series) approval and approval marking on the lamp for the reversing function.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the illuminating surface above ground on unladen vehicle per R48 procedures; pass if lowest point ≥ 250 mm and highest point ≤ 1,200 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify reversing lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle α shall be 15° upwards and 5° downwards, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7: verify unobstructed apparent surface from 15° up to 5° down relative to reference axis; pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: If there are two reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle β shall be 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7 for each of the two lamps: verify visibility over 45° outwards and 30° inwards; pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify reference axis of the reversing lamp is directed rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the reversing lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: engage reverse gear with propulsion system operable; pass if lamp switches ON only under both conditions.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: with lamp ON, disengage reverse gear, then separately switch propulsion control to off; also attempt activation with either condition unmet; pass if lamp is OFF in all cases.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check R23/R148 requirements for failure indication; if required, simulate lamp failure and verify tell-tale operates.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of category S1 or S2 shall be installed on the M1 category vehicle (mandatory).
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted on the M1 vehicle. Pass if present.

requirements.text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the S1/S2 stop lamps, handed unit plus mirrored opposite-side unit. Pass if exactly two are installed.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking on the lamp and the approval certificate. Pass if the approval is to UN R7 02+ series or UN R148 00+ series.

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of an S1 or S2 category stop lamp which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle, according to R48 para. 5.8 methods, the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle. Pass if ≤ 400 mm on each side.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be positioned not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the apparent surface above the ground with the vehicle unladen, per para. 5.8.1. Pass if the lowest edge is ≥ 350 mm and the highest edge is ≤ 1,500 mm, or ≤ 2,100 mm where the bodywork justifies it.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the vehicle installation. Pass if the lamp is mounted at the vehicle rear.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; for stop lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle per R48 para. 2.13 and 5.10. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed over 45° outward and 45° inward, or 20° inward under the H plane where the mounting height is < 750 mm.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed 15° up and 15° down, or 5° down where the mounting height is < 750 mm.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the reference axis direction on the vehicle. Pass if it points rearward.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on the vehicle: apply the brake signal and observe all stop lamps, including the S3/S4 lamp. Pass if all illuminate simultaneously.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatorily installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that the rear combination lamp contains a rear position lamp function approved as category R, R1 or R2 (approval marking check). Pass if present on the vehicle.

requirements.text: Two rear position lamps shall be installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the rear position lamps fitted (left-hand unit and mirrored right-hand unit). Pass if exactly two mandatory rear position lamps are installed.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify the approval mark on the lamp references UN R7 02 or later series, or UN R148 00 or later series. Pass if a valid approval exists.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Installation measurement on the vehicle: measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface (in the direction of the reference axis) to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle. Pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear position lamp shall be mounted above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Installation measurement with vehicle on substantially horizontal ground, measured according to paragraph 5.8.1: pass if the height is ≥ 350 mm and ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork shape makes 1,500 mm impossible and no optional lamps are fitted).

requirements.text: In length, the rear position lamps shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the rear combination lamp with the rear position lamp is mounted at the rear of the vehicle. Pass if located at the vehicle rear.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall cover a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards; however, where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the installed lamp: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface over 45° inwards and 80° outwards (inward angle 20° under the H plane permitted if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if the visibility angles are met.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall cover a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the installed lamp: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface 15° above and 15° below the horizontal (downward 5° permitted if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if the visibility angles are met.

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall cover a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: If the alternative is chosen, verify that a rear side-marker lamp is installed and that the apparent surface is visible over 45° outwards to 45° inwards (20° inwards under H plane if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if both conditions are met.

requirements.text: When the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, the geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall cover a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check: verify view of the apparent surface 15° above and below the horizontal (downward 5° permitted if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if met.

requirements.text: When the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, to be considered visible the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
requirements.test_case: At each direction within the alternative visibility angles, determine the unobstructed projected apparent surface of the rear position lamp, subtracting non-light-transmitting retro-reflector area. Pass if ≥ 12.5 cm² in every direction.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the reference axis of the rear position lamp points rearwards as installed. Pass if oriented rearwards.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps shall be mandatory, except when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle function test: switch on rear position lamps with DRL off and verify a closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates. Pass if tell-tale indicates switching ON.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamps shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify a single combined tell-tale operates for front and rear position lamps. Pass if combined.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp shall be mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check component Regulation (UN R7/R148) approval conditions; if failure indication required, simulate LED/light source failure and verify the failure tell-tale activates. Pass if activated.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify a non-triangular rear retro-reflector is fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count mandatory rear non-triangular retro-reflectors (one per handed unit); pass if exactly two mandatory devices.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking and certificate of the retro-reflector: pass if Class IA or IB per UN R3 02+ series or UN R150 00+ series.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Visual and photometric assessment on the vehicle: pass if any additional retro-reflecting device or material does not impair the mandatory rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the vehicle extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle (unladen, ground substantially horizontal) the height of the lowest point of the illuminating surface above ground; pass if ≥ 250 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not more than 900 mm above the ground, or not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), or 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the highest point of the illuminating surface above ground; pass if ≤ 1,200 mm (grouped with rear lamps in the combination lamp), or ≤ 1,500 mm with bodywork-shape justification.

requirements.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be situated at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle or CAD: verify the illuminating surface is unobstructed over 30° inwards and 30° outwards; pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and below horizontal; however, where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check: verify unobstructed visibility 10° upwards and 10° downwards (5° downwards if mounting height < 750 mm per para. 5.8.1.); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the retro-reflector reference axis points rearwards; pass if rearward facing.

requirements.text: Red light from the rear position lamp and stop lamp functions shall not be directly visible to the eye of an observer moving within zone 1, in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see paragraph 5.10.4.). Zone 1 is bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Visibility check per Annex 4 with the lamp installed on the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground. Explore zone 1 in front of the vehicle between eye heights of 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground. Pass if no red light from the lamp, including its illuminated surface or reflections, is directly visible from any point in the zone.

requirements.text: For verifying that red light is not visible to the front, zone 1 shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes. Each plane forms an angle of 15° outwards to the front from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane. Each plane passes through the point of contact of the vertical planes parallel to the median longitudinal plane that delimit the vehicle's overall width. If there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric or CAD sightline analysis per Annex 4. Construct 15° outward vertical planes through the foremost overall-width contact points and, from the zone 1 envelope (1 m to 2.2 m height) bounded by these planes, check sightlines to the lamp's red light-emitting surfaces. Pass if no red light-emitting surface is directly visible.
